items.title: Marian McPartland — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: He’s somebody that . . . Stanley Dance is always saying to me, “Why don’t you have Cliff Smalls,” and I’ve tried, but he’s always working somewhere, gone to Japan or something

ctx.x: It sounds like Harold Mabern or someone who’s very steady, very consistent. Class act all the time.
Yeah. Absolutely. There’s another guy I didn’t think of. Harold Mabern. There’s a guy. He’s doing an awful lot. Cliff Smalls. Do you know him?
